title: A city that celebrates Death | Varanasi
subtext: Beyond the rituals and religious beliefs, Kashi offers a different perspective on life, death and everything in between.

title: Becoming of a Divine | Theyyam
subtext: Theyyam is more than a ritual or a performance. It is a deeply rooted tradition of faith, devotion and worship, where elaborate costumes, vibrant face paintings, rhythmic drums and fire come together in a powerful spiritual experience.
